messages.text: BL-1634 🎵 in progress — BL-829's landed scenario 'a malformed page list rejects the whole manifest' is red on main since BL-1166 landed the bridge's built-in pages (2026-08-27): its handler demands an EMPTY offered list where the scenario says no page FROM the malformed manifest is offered, so the built-in health, host and operator-docs pages fail it - first recorded 2026-09-18 by the coder on BL-775, which adds a fourth built-in, `live`, the very id the fixture's malformed entry uses; the handler asserts by id, the fixture's id is one no built-in will ever carry, and the row leaves in this land
